name: TacoBoutIT: Taco Bell menu prices across the US
about: An independent price study. Not affiliated with Taco Bell or Yum! Brands.
caveats: Online pickup prices from Taco Bell's ordering site, not in-store menu boards.
Before tax, before deals, rewards or app-only offers.
Each restaurant is counted under the city on its mailing address.
Every figure traces to a collected price; nothing is estimated. A missing price is null.
Prices change; this is one weekly snapshot, dated below.

The site and these files were built with AI help. The prices are collected, not generated, but summaries and labels can contain mistakes. Report one at https://github.com/domoretechnet/tacobout-data/issues.

full_price_table: Every restaurant x every item, as CSV: https://github.com/domoretechnet/tacobout-data/releases/latest
fetching: Plain static files, updated weekly. Download what you need once and cache it; everything together is a few MB.

files.what: Headline numbers and the item catalogue. meta = collection run; items = every item with national median/min/max and coverage; states = per-state 12-item median, min, max; featured = the 40 item codes that per-restaurant files are aligned to; store_columns / city_columns = column order for stores.json and cities.json.

files.shape: array of arrays, one per restaurant, in store_columns order

columns.id: Taco Bell store number (string, keep leading zeros)
columns.x: position on the site's 960x600 SVG map (ignore for analysis)
columns.basket: total of the 12-item order in USD, null if any of the 12 is not sold there
columns.book: price-book number (index into books.json); restaurants sharing one charge identical prices
columns.near: Census place the restaurant is counted under
columns.tier: the study's size band for that place: peer, mid, major, coverage, or town

files.shape: array of arrays, one per city, in city_columns order

columns.pop: population (null if under the index minimum)

files.what: Per-restaurant prices for one state: {store id: [price per featured item]}. Position i is dashboard.json featured[i]; null = not sold there.
One item across states: by_state median, state_min, state_max, state_counts, and hist = [[price, restaurants], ...]. Codes are in dashboard.json items.
Price books: groups of restaurants charging identical prices, with their states and towns.
Census places of min_pop or more: [name, state, population, lat, lon, tier]. Used for city search.
